name: 掌柜的铁算盘
text: 商店中所有商品价格降低20%。
flavor: 珠子是铁的，拨起来响，砍价也响。

art.subject: a heavy black iron abacus with worn beads, a merchant's hand flicking one bead, coins scattered on a counter

name: 九转药葫
flavor: 葫芦里九道弯，每道弯藏一颗丹。

art.subject: a large lacquered medicine gourd with nine carved spiral bands, a red cord and small pill bottles hanging from it

name: 地宫拍卖槌
text: 每击败一名精英，额外获得1件遗物。
flavor: 地下的拍卖行只收一种货：从强者身上扒下来的。

art.subject: a carved dark wooden auction gavel resting on a bronze sound block, shadowy bidders' masks in the background

name: 百工宝匣
text: 战斗奖励中的卡牌均已升级。
flavor: 匣中百件器物，件件都经过第二道工。

art.subject: an open craftsman's treasure chest filled with tiny finely worked tools and gleaming finished trinkets, warm workshop light

name: 净业铜盆
text: 商店移除卡牌的价格降低50%。
flavor: 洗手的水倒掉，业也就少了一点。

art.subject: a shallow bronze washbasin filled with clear water, a single ink-stained card dissolving into it, soft light

name: 说书人醒木
text: 战斗开始时，从抽牌堆中选择1张牌加入手牌。
flavor: 啪的一声，故事就翻到了你想听的那一回。

art.subject: a polished rectangular wooden gavel block of a storyteller slammed on a table, a folding fan beside it, teahouse lamplight
